decisions.rationale: Leukemia cutis (myeloid sarcoma) matches the description of the patient's condition, with skin lesions and a history of multiple myeloma, and is equivalent to the leaf labels 'Leukemia cutis' and 'Leukemic cutis'.
Sweet's syndrome (acute febrile neutrophilic dermatosis) does not match the patient's condition, as the skin biopsy findings and laboratory results do not support this diagnosis.
Sweet syndrome (atypical/neutropenic) does not match the patient's condition, as the skin biopsy findings and laboratory results do not support this diagnosis.
Histiocytoid Sweet syndrome does not match the patient's condition, as the skin biopsy findings and laboratory results do not support this diagnosis.
